about: Wikimedia Commons Action API fixtures (formatversion=2) for the step 3 tests. Shapes follow MediaWiki core 560efe7b50d4073a7c02d91990ea5aec73fc3396 (identical API code to the deployed branch wmf/1.47.0-wmf.23, 838c378492f0dbb331b4e188917dc8953e8897b8): includes/Api/ApiQuery.php outputGeneralPageInfo, ApiQuerySearch.php, ApiPageSet.php, ApiQueryImageInfo.php getInfo, ApiContinuationManager.php, ApiMain.php checkMaxLag and substituteResultWithError, ApiErrorFormatter_BackCompat.php; includes/Media/FormatMetadata.php; extension CommonsMetadata 28eaa465bb1b406f90575e6b684c9365265b441e (TemplateParser, LicenseParser, DataCollector); Wikimedia production settings from operations/mediawiki-config ab324f326fd7df4213ce2500bbdf3fcdcbeb4988 ($wgThumbnailSteps, $wgTrackMediaRequestProvenance, $wgShowHostnames); edge responses from operations/puppet 135df70c1ea0fb023993c3c0b0ab80979af8d409. extmetadata values, hidden flags and HTML patterns copy real Commons responses captured in WordPress/openverse c815ba4942a3d53cb687d51121f7d44caec7b7e3 (catalog/tests/dags/providers/provider_api_scripts/resources/wikimedia). Upload paths use the real md5 hash layout. Page ids, users and files are synthetic; four of them are the same files as Commons-sourced records in ../openverse/search-rolex-submariner.json (curid 148213907, 150337412, 67324118, 118904562).

request_headers_expected.note: Any UA that contains an http(s) URL or an e-mail address counts as contact info at the Wikimedia edge (puppet modules/profile/files/cache/contact_info.lua). Without a User-Agent header the edge answers 403; the n8n default "axios/<version>" matches the library-default regex and is also answered 403 unless it carries contact info (edge-403-ua-policy.txt).

search-rolex-submariner.json.notes: 11 pages, no continue (fewer hits than gsrlimit), batchcomplete true. query.pages is in database order (binary title order, as ApiPageSet selects from `page` without ORDER BY); relevance order is the 'index' field (1-based, offset+position). Array order of index values: 5,10,3,11,1,2,4,6,8,9,7. iiurlwidth=1920 is a $wgThumbnailSteps step: files wider than 1920 get a /thumb/.../1920px- URL; narrower files get the ORIGINAL url as thumburl (utm_content=thumbnail_unscaled) while thumbwidth still reports the requested 1920 and thumbheight the matching upscaled height. Every url, thumburl and responsiveUrls value carries utm_source/utm_campaign/utm_content query parameters ($wgTrackMediaRequestProvenance, T414338); strip the query before using a URL as a dedupe key.

search-rolex-watch-no-filetype.json.notes: NOT a response to the recommended request: filetype:bitmap excludes MEDIATYPE_DRAWING, so SVGs never come back from it. Use only to unit-test the mime/extension filter and the vector thumb shape. 2 SVG pages (thumburl is a PNG render at 1920px; width/height are the SVG nominal size). Shows a continue block: {"gsroffset": 2, "continue": "gsroffset||"} with batchcomplete true. Page 2 is the same file as Openverse result 8 (curid 96530177).

search-empty.json.notes: No hits: no "query" key at all (ApiQuery::outputGeneralPageInfo only adds query.pages when count($pages) > 0; gsrinfo defaults to empty in generator mode, so no query.searchinfo).

error-maxlag.json.notes: HTTP 200 (dieWithError without an HTTP code). Retry-After is max(maxlag, 5); X-Database-Lag is the integer lag. error carries host, lag (float), type from $lagInfo; info names the host because $wgShowHostnames is true in production; docref under "docref" (formatversion=1 puts it under "*"). servedby is forced on errors.

error-generic.json.notes: Search backend failure: CirrusSearch returns Status::newFatal(cirrussearch-backend-error), ApiQuerySearch calls dieStatus. Same envelope as every API error: {error:{code, info, docref}, servedby}, HTTP 200.

error-urlparamnormal.json.notes: Caused by iiurlwidth itself: ApiQueryImageInfo::checkParameterNormalise dies for the whole request when one file in the result set cannot be normalised (source width <= 0, i.e. a broken upload). The file name in info is the DB key (underscores).

error-internal.json.notes: Uncaught exception: code internal_api_error_<class without Wikimedia\Rdbms\>, errorclass, info "[<request id>] Caught exception of type <class>" ($wgShowExceptionDetails is false on commonswiki); no docref.

edge-403-ua-policy.txt.request: any request with no User-Agent, or a library-default User-Agent (python-requests, axios, java, go-, okhttp, guzzlehttp, ...) without contact info
edge-403-ua-policy.txt.notes: Answered by the HAProxy TLS terminator before MediaWiki (puppet modules/profile/templates/cache/haproxy/tls_terminator.cfg.erb, http-request deny ... ua_policy_body). Not JSON.

edge-429-bot-ratelimit.html.request: any request from a UA with contact info above 100 cache misses per 10 s per contact (text cluster, commons.wikimedia.org) or 10 per 10 s (upload.wikimedia.org)
edge-429-bot-ratelimit.html.notes: Varnish synth error page (modules/varnish/templates/errorpage.inc.vcl.erb synth_errorpage + modules/mediawiki/templates/errorpage.html.erb). The reason string is the text-cluster bot limit message; host names, XID, date and IP are synthetic. Not JSON.
